author: Aditya Singh
title: Every Agent Needs a Safe Degradation Ladder
subtitle: Production resilience means reducing authority deliberately before the system reaches an emergency stop.
description: A control-plane blueprint for moving AI agents through autonomous, reviewed, recommend-only, read-only, and contained operating modes.
heroAlt: Six-stage safe degradation control-plane architecture from sensing and mode decisions through epoch propagation, enforcement, and recovery.

blocks.html: Most agent platforms expose two operational modes: enabled and disabled. Real incidents do not arrive in binary form. Retrieval quality drifts, a verifier lags, a model route degrades, an approver queue saturates, or one tool starts returning ambiguous outcomes.

blocks.html: A kill switch is essential for containment, but it is the last rung. A safe degradation ladder lets the control plane remove classes of authority as evidence weakens—preserving useful work without pretending the original autonomy contract still holds.

blocks.html: Degradation should reduce reachable consequence monotonically, with explicit entry signals, exit evidence, and independent enforcement.

blocks.html: Feature flags do not define a safety state
blocks.text: Feature flags do not define a safety state

blocks.html: Turning off one planner while queued work, cached credentials, delegated agents, or direct tool tokens remain active can create the appearance of safety. A mode must be enforced at every effect boundary and attached to an epoch so stale workers cannot commit under an earlier state.

blocks.html: Recovery is equally risky. If operators re-enable autonomy because error rate looks normal for five minutes, unresolved effects and verifier backlogs may return with it. Exit needs a proof bundle: root cause bounded, ambiguous actions reconciled, controls healthy, canary passed, and accountable authority recorded.

blocks.html: Make operating mode a control-plane primitive
blocks.text: Make operating mode a control-plane primitive

blocks.html: A mode controller ingests effect SLOs, dependency health, policy changes, drift signals, incident commands, and reviewer capacity. It advances a signed mode epoch and distributes it to schedulers, workers, gateways, queues, and verifiers. Each enforcement point rejects authority issued under an older or more permissive epoch.

blocks.html: A five-rung ladder is a useful start: autonomous bounded action; mandatory human review; recommend-only output; read-only investigation; and contained. Each action class maps to permitted effects in each mode. Higher-risk actions can degrade earlier than routine internal work.

blocks.html: Choose the least restrictive safe mode
blocks.text: Choose the least restrictive safe mode

blocks.html: Mode selection can be expressed as constrained utility:
blocks.text: Mode selection can be expressed as constrained utility:

m* = argmax_m Utility(m)
subject to: Exposure(m) ≤ RiskBudget
            VerificationCapacity(m) ≥ RequiredProof(m)
            AmbiguityAge(m) ≤ Deadline(m)
and ReachableAuthority(m_down) ⊆ ReachableAuthority(m_up)

blocks.html: The subset condition prevents a lower rung from accidentally adding a path. Utility includes retained service value; exposure includes action scope, rate, reversibility, and dependency uncertainty.
blocks.text: The subset condition prevents a lower rung from accidentally adding a path. Utility includes retained service value; exposure includes action scope, rate, reversibility, and dependency uncertainty.

blocks.html: Bind every capability to a mode epoch
blocks.text: Bind every capability to a mode epoch

blocks.html: Enforcement should compare both authority and current operating mode:
blocks.text: Enforcement should compare both authority and current operating mode:

{
  "lease_id": "lease_91",
  "action_class": "crm.material_write",
  "mode": "reviewed",
  "mode_epoch": 1842,
  "issued_after_approval": "apr_52",
  "max_uses": 1,
  "expires_in_seconds": 90
}

accept iff lease.mode_epoch == control.current_epoch
       and action in control.allowed[lease.mode]

blocks.html: Queued work must be re-evaluated when the epoch changes. A message accepted under autonomous mode cannot remain pre-authorized after the system moves to recommend-only.

blocks.html: Track time to effective degradation, stale-epoch rejection, residual reachable authority, work retained by lower modes, ambiguity closed before restoration, canary escape rate, and unplanned mode flapping. Availability without bounded consequence is not resilience.

blocks.html: A design review cannot prove Every downward transition removes authority; every upward transition requires new evidence. The pre-production harness must interrupt the system at the transitions where ownership, authority, evidence, and business state can disagree. The objective is not to maximize a generic pass rate. It is to demonstrate that every material fault produces a bounded state, a named owner, and an admissible recovery transition.

rows: Pause the path after REVIEWED and release it after CONTAINED
The stale path cannot manufacture terminal success
Advance policy, mode, ownership, or resource version before effect commit
The final gateway rejects the old decision context
Remove one authoritative observation or change its digest
The outcome remains violated, inconclusive, or owned—never guessed
Interrupt compensation, handoff, or receipt closure
The action stays visible with an owner, deadline, and next legal transition

blocks.html: Run the matrix at concurrency, with realistic dependency lag and with the same policy and gateway versions used in the candidate release. Report p95 and p99 resolution alongside the worst unresolved example. Averages can demonstrate throughput; they cannot erase a single material breach. Promotion should require replayable evidence for the controls, not a slide stating that the team considered the risk.

blocks.html: Three questions for the architecture review
blocks.text: Three questions for the architecture review

blocks.html: Where is truth decided? Name the authoritative source and the exact component permitted to advance the workflow into a terminal state. If the answer is ‘the agent interprets the tool response,’ the boundary is not yet independent.
blocks.text: Where is truth decided? Name the authoritative source and the exact component permitted to advance the workflow into a terminal state. If the answer is ‘the agent interprets the tool response,’ the boundary is not yet independent.

blocks.html: Where is authority finally enforced? Follow the command through every queue, adapter, cache, provider, and downstream effect. A policy decision is useful only when the last material write boundary can reject a stale, changed, or excessive action.
blocks.text: Where is authority finally enforced? Follow the command through every queue, adapter, cache, provider, and downstream effect. A policy decision is useful only when the last material write boundary can reject a stale, changed, or excessive action.

blocks.html: What blocks promotion? Convert the scorecard into executable gates with owners and expiry. A breached tail metric must reduce scope, hold the cohort, or enter an approved exception path; it cannot remain decorative telemetry.

blocks.html: A practical implementation sequence
blocks.text: A practical implementation sequence

blocks.html: 1. Enumerate effect classes. Map each tool action to the five modes and prove lower modes never add authority.
blocks.text: 1. Enumerate effect classes. Map each tool action to the five modes and prove lower modes never add authority.

blocks.html: 2. Introduce mode epochs. Have every gateway reject stale leases and re-evaluate queued work.
blocks.text: 2. Introduce mode epochs. Have every gateway reject stale leases and re-evaluate queued work.

blocks.html: 3. Exercise the ladder. Run game days for verifier lag, model drift, approver saturation, and compromised credentials before relying on full containment.
blocks.text: 3. Exercise the ladder. Run game days for verifier lag, model drift, approver saturation, and compromised credentials before relying on full containment.

blocks.html: Degraded modes should not be used to bypass obligations owed to customers or regulators. They are technical safety states; business continuity and legal decisions still need accountable owners.

blocks.html: The operating conclusion
blocks.text: The operating conclusion

blocks.html: The choice is not full autonomy or zero value. A mature control plane can retain analysis, evidence gathering, and recommendations while progressively withdrawing the authority that current evidence no longer justifies.
blocks.text: The choice is not full autonomy or zero value. A mature control plane can retain analysis, evidence gathering, and recommendations while progressively withdrawing the authority that current evidence no longer justifies.

blocks.html: When one verifier or tool degrades, can your system reduce only the affected authority—or does it keep everything running until someone pulls the plug?
